Elecsys CSF Aβ42/Aβ40 agreement depended partly on specimen storage

An automated CSF amyloid ratio agreed well with PET overall; storage and choice of PET reference both affected interpretation.

Key quantitative results: At 0.097, unadjusted ratio PPA/NPA was 87.7%/92.4% versus visual PET (n=243) and 83.8%/93.4% versus Centiloid ≥24 (n=247).

Added November 23, 2026 · ctad-2026-p226-elecsys-csf-ratio

Evidence summaryDesign, results, and what changed

Thirty-second field brief

An automated CSF amyloid ratio agreed well with PET overall; storage and choice of PET reference both affected interpretation. Keep routine and banked-specimen workflows separate when validating a cutoff.

Study design

Secondary analysis of 247 APPPROACH participants across PET reference definitions, including a storage-adjusted subset of 49.

Key quantitative results

  • At 0.097, unadjusted ratio PPA/NPA was 87.7%/92.4% versus visual PET (n=243) and 83.8%/93.4% versus Centiloid ≥24 (n=247).
  • In the subset with adjustment for 38–65 weeks’ storage, PPA/NPA was 100%/85.7% versus visual reads and 91.3%/84.6% versus Centiloid ≥24.

What changed

At 0.097, unadjusted ratio PPA/NPA was 87.7%/92.4% versus visual PET (n=243) and 83.8%/93.4% versus Centiloid ≥24 (n=247).

Strength of evidence

Conference secondary diagnostic-validity analysis. Key constraints: sponsor conference analysis.

Clinical and field impactInterpretation, implementation, and access

Clinical significance

Keep routine and banked-specimen workflows separate when validating a cutoff.

Field medical relevance

Interpret alongside these constraints: Small storage subset; No independent prospective validation of the cutoff.

Quanterix or platform relevance

Keep routine and banked-specimen workflows separate when validating a cutoff.

Access or reimbursement relevance

These results do not by themselves establish routine availability or payer coverage.

Likely questionsWhat you may hear and what the evidence supports
Can the same cutoff be applied to samples stored under different conditions?
Not on this evidence; storage-related changes require local study.
Critique and limitationsBias, uncertainty, and missing evidence
  • Sponsor conference analysis
  • Small storage subset
  • No independent prospective validation of the cutoff
